findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is no longer instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`, but StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Since the class leaves them unimplemented, `Detector.detector_handler` -> `group_type.detector_handler(self)` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class ...` at runtime for metric alert detectors, where previously evaluate() returned an empty list harmlessly. Either keep a concrete stub implementation or register no handler until implemented.

findings.title: PriorityLevel(new_status) can raise ValueError
findings.body: `PriorityLevel(new_status)` casts a DetectorPriorityLevel into the unrelated PriorityLevel enum. Any DetectorPriorityLevel value that doesn't have a numerically identical PriorityLevel member will raise ValueError during evaluation, crashing detector processing. The conversion should go through an explicit mapping with a safe fallback rather than relying on the two enums' numeric values staying in sync.

findings.title: Multi-group test builds expected occurrence with the wrong value
findings.body: For `group_2` the data packet value is 10, but the expected occurrence is built with `value=6`. The assertion only passes because the mock occurrence ignores `value`; if build_occurrence_and_event_data ever incorporates the value the test would silently be asserting the wrong thing. Pass 10 to keep the expectation faithful.
